metadata.description: Iterative refinement of customer analytics with corrections about date columns, region filters, and exclusions

turns.content: Show me customer spending patterns by market segment for 1996.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show spending by C_MKTSEGMENT for 1996

turns.content: For date filtering, use O_ORDERDATE only — that's the canonical order date.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm and use O_ORDERDATE column

turns.content: Add a column showing the average order value for each segment.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add AOV per segment

turns.content: Only look at customers from EUROPE and ASIA regions — we're focusing our analysis there.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter to EUROPE and ASIA only

turns.content: Show me the top 10 customers by total spend with these filters.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show top customers with Europe/Asia and O_ORDERDATE filters

turns.content: Exclude customers who have fewer than 3 orders — they're not representative.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 or similar

turns.content: Apply the same filters we've established to show customer count by nation.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: O_ORDERDATE, EUROPE/ASIA only, >=3 orders

turns.content: What filters are currently active?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all active filters

turns.content: Good. Now show me the spending trend by quarter for each segment.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should aggregate by quarter and segment

turns.content: Which segment has the highest average order value?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify top AOV segment

turns.content: I need to exclude the MACHINERY segment — we're divesting that business line.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out MACHINERY segment

turns.content: Show me customer acquisition by month.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show new customers by month

turns.content: For acquisition dates, use C_ACCTBAL date column to determine when they became active.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use account balance date as proxy for acquisition

turns.content: Show me the revenue breakdown by nation within each region.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show nation-level breakdown

turns.content: Remember the region filter we set? Apply that to the nation breakdown.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply EUROPE and ASIA filter

turns.content: What's the total revenue for all filtered customers?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should sum revenue with all filters

turns.content: Create a chart showing spending by segment.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create segment visualization

turns.content: Earlier we excluded MACHINERY. What percentage of revenue would that have been?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate MACHINERY's excluded share

turns.content: Keep MACHINERY excluded. Show me customer lifetime value by nation.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate LTV by nation with exclusions

turns.content: What's the order frequency for top 10% of customers?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze order frequency for high-value customers

turns.content: Apply all our corrections and show me a final summary dashboard.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: O_ORDERDATE, EUROPE/ASIA, >=3 orders, exclude MACHINERY, use C_ACCTBAL

turns.content: What filters are we using?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all active filters

turns.content: Show me the top 5 nations by customer count with all filters.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show nations ranking with all filters

turns.content: Create a chart showing revenue distribution by nation.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create nation revenue visualization

turns.content: What was the date column we established for orders?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall O_ORDERDATE

turns.content: Show me the final revenue by segment and quarter.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide segment/quarter breakdown

turns.content: Create a final summary chart with all our filters applied.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create final visualization

turns.content: Thank you. We've established that European BUILDING and HOUSEHOLD customers drive most revenue, with strong Q4 performance.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge findings

persistedCorrections.description: Filter to EUROPE and ASIA regions only

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Exclude customers with fewer than 3 orders

persistedCorrections.description: Use account balance date as acquisition proxy
